definition: positives = risky test events from behavioural templates (bursts, ramps, out-of-scope access, split exfiltration, amount outliers, structuring, post-elevation export); negatives = safe test events

isolation_forest.note: global model over the same behavioural features; no per-actor context

fusion.decision: Anomaly is shown to reviewers and used for routing; it escalates on its own only for high-impact actions, and only if it adds recall without breaching the hard-negative FPR budget.
